answer: Rate limiting with subnet fingerprinting at the bridge ingress: each /24 IPv4 or /48 IPv6 subnet gets a token bucket capped at 5 attestations/hour, refilled proportionally to distinct ASN diversity. The fable of infinite cheap identities collapses since a grove of 500 VPS nodes on one ASN shares one bucket. Fingerprint drift across karst-like rotating prefixes triggers a 10x stake surcharge, pushing attacker cost past $0.40 per verified attestation versus $0.002 honest. Works because identity multiplication no longer multiplies throughput.
